name: c8i-96xl
description: c8i.metal-96xl - custom Intel Xeon 6975P-C (Granite Rapids), dual socket, SNC3
numa_mode: SNC3 - 3 compute dies per socket x 2 sockets = 6 NUMA domains of 32 cores

confidence.cpu_model: verified - Intel Xeon 6975P-C, 192 physical / 384 logical, 960 MiB L3 total (480 per socket)
confidence.numa_nodes: SNC3 default on Xeon 6900P, confirmed as AWS's chosen mode. 2 sockets x 3 dies = 6 NUMA nodes.
confidence.cores_per_l3: 480 MiB per socket / 3 dies = 160 MiB per die; 96 cores / 3 = 32 cores per L3 domain.
confidence.nic_numa_node: ASSUMED node 0. Under SNC3 the PCIe root ports live on the I/O dies that flank the three compute dies, so firmware assigns the NIC to an EDGE domain of one socket - node 0 or node 2 if that socket is socket 0. Settle it with 'lltune nic --live'.

nic_locality: 2 sockets x SNC3 - only ~1/6 of the machine is NIC-local
